caption: The app opens on its plans: Free covers 50 products, 50 metafields and 5 articles with the built in AI and 1 language; Starter is $4.99 a month. The store name is hidden.
Adding Dutch took one step; the language stays unpublished (Market: None) until you switch it on. We left it off, so we never saw the shop in Dutch. The store name is hidden.
The built in AI on Free translated our products into Dutch in about 2 minutes. The title came out in Dutch, the handle stayed empty and the product type stayed English. The store name is hidden.
Basic is $19.99 a month (our dossier had $14.99) and Pro $29.99. Auto AI Translations appears only on the Pro card. The store name is hidden.
Starter is $4.99 every 30 days plus usage charges up to $30 per 30 days. Shopify asked for a payment method and we approved nothing. The store name is hidden.
